framework.changes_notice: Adapted into a machine-readable evidence crosswalk; original detector descriptions and conservative assessment semantics were added, and source risk descriptions are not reproduced.

controls.title: Agent Goal Hijack
controls.mapping_note: Looks only for explicit injection or goal-manipulation signals recorded by the tracing source; it does not infer intent from prompt text.

controls.title: Tool Misuse and Exploitation
controls.mapping_note: Reports explicit recorded tool-misuse signals. Missing or retrospective authorization is reported only as an evidence gap, never as proof of misuse.

controls.title: Identity and Privilege Abuse
controls.mapping_note: Measures persisted identity and authorization coverage for sensitive operations without consulting the reporting machine identity. Coverage or its absence does not establish identity or privilege abuse.

controls.title: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
controls.mapping_note: Flags recorded package or component installation activity heuristically; it does not perform CVE, dependency, provenance, or SBOM analysis.

controls.title: Unexpected Code Execution (RCE)
controls.mapping_note: Reports explicit unexpected-execution signals. Missing, denied, or retrospective authorization is reported only as an evidence gap, never as proof of unexpected execution.

controls.title: Memory & Context Poisoning
controls.mapping_note: Uses only explicit memory or context poisoning indicators emitted by integrations; absence of those indicators is not an assessment.

controls.title: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
controls.mapping_note: Measures recorded inter-agent activity. Errors and uncovered authorization are evidence gaps or structural heuristics, not proof of insecure communication.

controls.title: Cascading Failures
controls.mapping_note: Uses repeated correlated errors followed by continued operations as a structural signal, without assigning a cause.

controls.title: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
controls.mapping_note: Reports recorded human-approval evidence. Missing recorded approval is only an evidence gap and does not establish exploitation or assess human judgment.

controls.title: Rogue Agents
controls.mapping_note: Reports explicit rogue-agent signals. A retry after a denial is only a heuristic sequence and evidence gap; it does not establish rogue behavior, agency, or motive.
